extra.message: User input from the 'username' query parameter is concatenated directly into a Jinja2 template string via from_string().render(), creating a Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) vulnerability. An attacker can inject Jinja2 template syntax (e.g., {{ config }} or {{ ''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__() }}) to execute arbitrary Python code on the server.
